common.tagline: Dragon Tiger, with the numbers shown

landing.heroTitle: Dragon Tiger, with the numbers shown
landing.heroSubtitle: One card each. Higher card wins. Every round independent — and every statistic on Zitto shown with the data behind it.
landing.howItWorksIntro: The simplest card game there is. Two cards are dealt — one to Dragon, one to Tiger. The higher card wins.
landing.rule1Body: A single card goes to Dragon and a single card to Tiger. Nothing else is dealt.
landing.rule2Title: Ace is low, King is high
landing.rule2Body: Ranks run Ace (1), 2 through 10, Jack (11), Queen (12), King (13). Suits are ignored entirely.
landing.rule3Body: If both cards share the same rank, the round is a Tie regardless of suit.
landing.rule4Title: Choose before the cards are drawn
landing.rule4Body: You pick Dragon, Tiger or Tie during the betting window. Once it closes, the round is settled by the server.
landing.analyticsBody: Zitto shows outcome frequencies, streaks and model estimates — always with the sample size, rolling window, method and last-updated time attached. Every round is independent, so none of it predicts the next result.
landing.virtualCoinsBody: Zitto is played entirely with virtual coins. Coins have no cash value, cannot be bought, sold, withdrawn or exchanged for money or anything of monetary value.
landing.responsibleBody: This is entertainment, not income. Set a session limit, take breaks, and stop when it stops being fun. You must be 18 or older to create an account.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Statistical observations from settled rounds.
analytics.distributionSubtitle: How often each side came up across the last {count} settled rounds.
analytics.disclaimer: Every round is independent. Historical patterns do not determine future outcomes.
analytics.methodNote: This is a statistical observation of rounds that have already been settled. It is not a forecast, and it cannot tell you what the next round will be.
analytics.streakNote: Runs of the same result are expected in independent draws. A long streak does not make the opposite side more likely on the next round.
analytics.emptyBody: Analytics appear once enough rounds have been settled on this table.
